snippet.title: Shattered Realms - Death Realm Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Gameplay trailer for Shattered Realms, an upcoming action roguelite ARPG. The first level, the Death Realm, will be fully playable in the upcoming free demo. Check it out on Steam and wishlist the game to stay up to date on development!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3717490/Shattered_Realms/

Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/7Mx2qjd9T5
